basics.name: David Val-Izevbigie
basics.summary: Fullstack Engineer specializing in scalable SaaS platforms, fintech systems, and AI-driven applications. Experienced in designing multi-tenant architectures, high-throughput systems, and real-time applications with a focus on performance, reliability, and production-scale impact.

highlights: Architected multi-tenant SaaS platform supporting multiple organizations and managing 1,000+ talent profiles
Designed and implemented RBAC, authentication, and session management across distributed systems
Built modular GraphQL backend using Apollo, improving development velocity and maintainability
Implemented Redis-based caching, rate limiting, and distributed locking, improving system performance under load
Engineered high-throughput productivity and time-tracking system handling ~24 requests per user/hour across 40+ concurrent users over sustained 8-hour usage periods
Developed real-time ticketing and workflow system with audit trails for operational transparency
Built AI-powered recruitment assistant automating candidate screening and structured evaluations
Developed cross-platform applications (Electron + React Native) with offline-first architecture and background synchronization
Led development of StockPulse AI POS and inventory intelligence system for real-time stock and sales operations
Implemented transactional consistency and real-time inventory tracking, reducing discrepancies across business workflows
Designed AI-driven demand forecasting and profit optimization systems for data-informed decision-making
Built fintech payment infrastructure with Paystack integration for secure and reliable transactions
Implemented multi-party payment splitting (fees, VAT, payouts) for complex financial flows
Developed real-time communication systems and cross-platform applications
Improved user engagement by 35% through gamification and behavioral incentive mechanisms
Developed multi-tenant school management SaaS platform used by 200+ schools
Built scalable academic, student, and staff management systems supporting large institutional datasets
Designed GraphQL APIs using Apollo for efficient and structured data access
Built offline-first mobile applications using SQLite with reliable synchronization
Integrated AI-assisted academic analytics and reporting systems
Automated report generation workflows, significantly reducing manual administrative effort
Delivered fullstack web and mobile solutions for multiple clients across industries
Designed backend systems and integrated responsive frontend applications
Improved performance, scalability, and reliability of deployed applications
